units.source_text: 夕雾随伴父亲巡回访问了许多不易对付的女人，心中不免沉闷。

en.t: Yugiri accompanied his father on rounds to visit many difficult women, and he could not help feeling gloomy.

units.source_text: 忽然想起，今天早上应该写一封信。

en.t: Suddenly he remembered that he ought to have written a letter that morning.

units.source_text: 还不曾写，而太阳已经高升。

en.t: He had not written it yet, and the sun was already high.

units.source_text: 他便来到小女公子那里。

en.t: So he went to the young lady's quarters.

units.source_text: 乳母对他说道：“小姐还在夫人房里睡觉呢。

en.t: Her nurse said to him, "The young lady is still asleep in the lady's room.

units.source_text: 她昨夜被大风吓坏了，没有睡好，今朝还不曾起身。”

en.t: She was badly frightened by the great wind last night and did not sleep well, so she has not yet risen this morning."

units.source_text: 夕雾说：“昨夜的风可怕得很，我本想到这里来值宿，好当警卫。

en.t: Yugiri said, "Last night's wind was terribly frightening. I had meant to come here and stay the night on duty, so I could stand guard.

units.source_text: 只因太君很胆小，我只得去陪伴她。

en.t: But because the elder lady is so timid, I had no choice but to go and keep her company.

units.source_text: 小姐的娃娃房间有没有被风损坏？”

en.t: Was the young lady's doll room damaged by the wind?"

units.source_text: 他这一问，使得众侍女都笑了，答道：“这个房间么？

en.t: His question made all the waiting women laugh, and they answered, "This room?

units.source_text: 用扇子扇一阵风，小姐也害怕，何况昨夜那种狂风。

en.t: The young lady is frightened even if someone stirs up a little breeze with a fan, let alone by a gale like last night's.

units.source_text: 我们保护这个房间，吃力得很呢。”

en.t: It was very hard work for us to protect this room."

units.source_text: 夕雾问道：“有没有不很讲究的纸张？

en.t: Yugiri asked, "Do you have any paper that is not especially fine?

units.source_text: 还有，你们所用的砚台请借用一下。”

en.t: And please lend me the inkstone you use as well."

units.source_text: 一个侍女便从小女公子的橱里取出一卷信纸，放在砚盖里交给他。

en.t: One of the waiting women took a roll of letter paper from the young lady's cabinet, placed it on the inkstone lid, and handed it to him.

units.source_text: 夕雾说：“这个太高贵了，给我用不敢当呢。”

en.t: Yugiri said, "This is far too noble; I hardly deserve to use it."

units.source_text: 但他想起了小女公子的母亲身份低微，则又觉得不足重视，便写信了。

en.t: But when he remembered that the young lady's mother was of low rank, he decided it was not worth treating so solemnly, and wrote the letter.

units.source_text: 这信纸是紫色的，染成上深下渐淡。

en.t: The letter paper was purple, dyed dark at the top and gradually lighter toward the bottom.

units.source_text: 夕雾用心磨墨，又仔细察看笔尖，然后郑重其事地一挥而就，样子很优雅。

en.t: Yugiri ground the ink with care, examined the brush tip closely, and then, with great ceremony, wrote it all at once, looking very elegant as he did so.

units.source_text: 然而因为研习汉学，作风有些怪癖，那首诗不免缺乏风趣：

en.t: However, because he had studied Chinese learning, his style had certain peculiarities, and the poem inevitably lacked charm:
